title: IPC endpoint params
description:
Parameters naming one local endpoint (`admin.endpoints.revoke`).

2.0.0 (ADR-0067 decision 7, IPC major 3): every EndpointId here is the derived id of `endpoints/endpoint-id` 2.0.0 -- the 52-character name of the endpoint's Ed25519 key -- and a label of the grammar ADR-0067 retired is refused; no reader of the earlier major tolerates the value, so the shape takes a major.
